description: This file contains the PHP source code for the 'User' model within the OpenCart admin module. It defines a class with methods for managing user data, including creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving user information from the database.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents the user model for admin users, providing methods to perform CRUD operations and other user-related database interactions.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Inserts a new user record into the database with the provided data, returning the new user ID.

methods.name: editUser
methods.description: Updates an existing user's information identified by user ID with the given data. Also updates password if provided.

methods.name: editPassword
methods.description: Updates the password for a specific user.

methods.name: editCode
methods.description: Sets or updates a code associated with a user identified by email.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Removes a user and related authorization and login records from the database.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a user specified by user ID, including user group name.

methods.name: getUserByUsername
methods.description: Fetches user details based on the username.

methods.name: getUserByEmail
methods.description: Fetches user details based on the email address.

methods.name: getUserByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a user based on a unique code.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of users with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalUsers
methods.description: Counts total number of users matching optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalUsersByGroupId
methods.description: Counts the number of users within a specific user group.

methods.name: getTotalUsersByEmail
methods.description: Counts users with a specific email address.

methods.name: addLogin
methods.description: Records a user login event with IP and user agent.

methods.name: deleteLogins
methods.description: Deletes all login records for the specified user.

methods.name: deleteLogins
methods.description: Deletes all login records for a specified user ID.

methods.name: getLogins
methods.description: Retrieves a list of login entries for a specified user ID, with optional pagination.

methods.name: getTotalLogins
methods.description: Returns the total number of login records for a specified user ID.

methods.name: addAuthorize
methods.description: Inserts a new authorization record for a user with specific token, IP, and user agent data.

methods.name: editAuthorizeStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (active/inactive) of a user authorization by its ID.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotal
methods.description: Updates the total attribute of a user authorization identified by authorization ID.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotalByUserId
methods.description: Updates the total attribute of a user authorization for a given user ID.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizes
methods.description: Deletes authorizations for a user, optionally targeting a specific authorization ID.

methods.name: getAuthorize
methods.description: Fetches the authorization record by its ID.

methods.name: getAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Retrieves authorization details for a user based on token, along with attempts count.

methods.name: getAuthorizes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of authorizations for a user, with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAuthorizes
methods.description: Counts total number of authorizations for a user.

methods.name: getTotalAuthorize
methods.description: Counts total authorizations for a user.
